analysis.executive_summary: RUN-A-SUPPLIER-014-01: user confirmed completed; recorded human-active time 1448838 milliseconds; full timing confirmed; no independent quality score. RUN-B-SUPPLIER-014-02: user confirmed completed; recorded human-active time 271016 milliseconds; full timing confirmed; no independent quality score.

findings.title: Recorded human-active timing status
findings.observation: RUN-A-SUPPLIER-014-01: human-active time was recorded as 1448838 milliseconds.
possible_explanations: Hypothesis: Version A's output required additional manual verification/checking by the operator to feel confident despite meeting automated pass criteria.
Hypothesis: Version A introduced subtle anomalies that prompted extra human scrutiny but did not trigger intervention or rework flags.
evidence_needed: Detailed timestamped logs of operator actions showing verification steps (e.g., document review, cross-checks) during RUN-A.
Video or screen capture of the operator's interface to observe whether extra checking behavior occurred.

findings.title: Recorded human-active timing status
findings.observation: RUN-B-SUPPLIER-014-02: human-active time was recorded as 271016 milliseconds.
possible_explanations: Hypothesis: Version B's output was sufficiently clear that the operator needed minimal verification.
Hypothesis: Version B had fewer latent issues, reducing the need for extra human checking.
evidence_needed: Timestamped logs of operator actions during RUN-B to confirm low verification activity.
Comparison of verification step counts between RUN-A and RUN-B.

residual_human_work.work: Human checking or correction work recorded
residual_human_work.observed_context: RUN-A-SUPPLIER-014-01/EV-007: a reviewed human-authored event was recorded.
evidence_needed: Specific description of the checking or correction work performed in EV-007 (what was checked, why).
Outcome of that work (whether any changes were made or if it was purely confirmatory).

analysis.recommended_next_experiment: Run a blinded crossover test where the operator executes both versions without knowing which is which, while recording all verification actions (logs, video) and using the same automated pass/fail criteria to isolate version-dependent differences in human effort.
limitations: The analysis is limited to 2 reviewed runs: RUN-A-SUPPLIER-014-01, RUN-B-SUPPLIER-014-02.
No reviewed Human baseline was supplied.
User-confirmed completion is not independent business quality verification, a causal efficiency result, or enterprise ROI evidence.
Declared study context: same operator, repeated material, fixed run order, prior development exposure. Familiarity and order effects are not established as controlled.
